want: to edit a transaction field directly in the list by double-clicking it
soThat: I can fix small mistakes quickly without opening the full edit modal
acceptance: double-clicking a free-text cell (date, merchant, item, amount, or note) activates an inline input pre-filled with the current value
pressing Enter or clicking away commits the change and patches Supabase
pressing Escape cancels the edit and restores the original displayed value
double-clicking a predefined cell (category or wallet) shows a select dropdown pre-selected to the current value; choosing an option commits immediately
changes are applied optimistically; if the API call fails the row reverts to its original value
the edit icon opens the full modal for fields not editable inline such as transaction type and to-wallet
